# Descriptions
@@ 2
Caster summons an Elemental Servant (a Type I Entity) that gradually appears
over the course of two rounds. If it is not “controlled” or “Mastered”
(usually by one of the spells on this list); it will attack random targets
until it fades away after 2-20 rounds.
@@ 3
Allows the caster to totally control a Type I Entity (the chance of
non-control is [the Entity’s Type x 2%]). The Entity leaves when the caster
stops concentrating. The Entity will not speak with the summoner.
@@ 4
As Summon Elemental I, except the caster summons a Weak Elemental (a Type II
entity).
@@ 5
Caster summons a Demon who gradually appears over the course of 2 rounds. Roll
d100 (not open-ended) for Type. A result of 01-60 is aType I; a result of
61-90 is a Type II; a result of 91-100 is a Type III. If the Demon is not
“Controlled” or “Mastered” (i.e., usually by one of the spells on this list)
before the Demon materializes, the caster suffers an effect as outlined in
Section 15.22 (p. 100).
@@ 6
As Control Entity I, except the caster need not concentrate to control the
Entity. The chance of failure is 5 times the Entity’s Type. The Entity will
remain and obey the caster until the caster is killed or the Entity is outside
the range limit or the caster releases him. A maximum of two Entities can be
mastered at one time by one being. Obtaining information may only be
accomplished by using spells off the Evil Magician’s Base list, Dark Contacts.
@@ 7
As Control Entity I, except Types I and II can be controlled.
@@ 8
As Summon Elemental I, except caster summons a Guardian Elemental (a Type III
Entity).
@@ 9
As Entity Mastery I, except Types I and II can be mastered.
@@ 10
As Control Entity I, except Types I-III can be controlled.
@@ 11
As Summon Elemental I, except caster summons a Strong Elemental (a Type IV
Entity).
@@ 12
As Lesser Demonic Gate, except Types III-VI can be summoned: (01-60) Type III,
(61-85) Type IV, (86-95) Type V, (96-100) Type VI.
@@ 13
As Entity Mastery I, except Types IIII can be mastered.
@@ 14
As Control Entity I, except Types I-IV can be controlled.
@@ 15
As Entity Mastery I, except Types I-IV can be mastered.
@@ 16
The target of this spell is any Mastered Elemental. The Elemental can be given
a simple, straightforward task that it will attempt to complete (within the
duration of the spell). When this spell expires, the Elemental returns to its
plane.
@@ 17
The target of this spell is any Mastered Elemental. The Elemental is contained
within an object (must be within 50% of the elemental’s actual size). The
Elemental will be released by a specific trigger (specified by the caster at
the time of casting). Possible triggers include touching the object, proximity
to the object, specific words spoken, etc.
@@ 18
As Order Elemental, except will work on any Mastered Entity.
@@ 19
As Contain Elemental, except will work on any Mastered Entity.
@@ 20
As Control Entity I, except Types I-V can be controlled.
@@ 25
As Entity Mastery I, except Types I-V can be mastered.
@@ 30
As Control Entity I, except Types I-VI can be controlled.
@@ 50
As Entity Mastery I, except Types I-VI can be mastered.
